name: Better Edit Menu
description: Restructures the editor's edit menu like BetterEdit does: groups move buttons directionally into a compact menu, and adds quarter/eighth/unit step move buttons

new-edit-menu.name: Grouped Edit Menu
new-edit-menu.description: Replaces the edit button bar with a compact menu that groups move buttons by direction. <cr>Requires re-entering the editor!</c>

extra-move-buttons.name: Extra Move Step Buttons
extra-move-buttons.description: Adds quarter-grid (7.5u @ grid 30), eighth-grid (3.75u), and pixel (0.1u) step move buttons to the edit menu
